response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS ana FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), per_sex AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(igg) AS avg_igg, AVG(ana) AS avg_ana FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_igg AS avg_aCL_IgG, avg_ana AS avg_ANA, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex
